taskResponse.9: Fully addresses all parts of the task with a fully developed position.
taskResponse.7: Addresses all parts; clear position with main ideas extended and supported.
taskResponse.6: Addresses all parts though some may be more fully covered than others.
taskResponse.5: Addresses the task only partially; position may be unclear.
taskResponse.4: Responds to the task only in a minimal way or tangentially.

coherenceAndCohesion.9: Uses cohesion so that the message is effortless to follow.
coherenceAndCohesion.7: Logically organises information with clear progression throughout.
coherenceAndCohesion.6: Arranges information coherently with overall progression.
coherenceAndCohesion.5: Organises information with some logical sequencing but lacks overall clarity.
coherenceAndCohesion.4: Presents information but not arranged coherently.

lexicalResource.9: Uses a wide range of vocabulary with very natural and sophisticated control.
lexicalResource.7: Uses a sufficient range of vocabulary with flexibility and precision.
lexicalResource.6: Uses an adequate range of vocabulary for the task.
lexicalResource.5: Uses a limited range of vocabulary; errors may cause difficulty.
lexicalResource.4: Uses only basic vocabulary which may be repetitive or inadequate.

grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy.9: Uses a wide range of structures with full flexibility and accuracy.
grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy.7: Uses a variety of complex structures with good control.
grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy.6: Uses a mix of simple and complex forms with some errors.
grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy.5: Uses only a limited range of structures with frequent errors.
grammaticalRangeAndAccuracy.4: Uses only a very limited range of structures with errors predominate.
